headline: Six Fronts See Rising Base Turnover and Casualties
war_summary: Three hours on, the war’s hottest sectors have sharpened. Callahans Passage remains the bloodiest theatre, its 24‑hour toll climbing to 12,195 Colonial and 14,434 Warden dead with 817 fresh enlistments and 64 ownership changes, six of them in the last two hours. Weathered Expanse follows closely, adding 10,052 Colonial and 15,474 Warden casualties, 518 recruits and 39 flips, three recorded in the past two hours. Fishermans Row has surged to 51 exchanges, casualties now at 597 Colonial and 656 Warden with 280 new troops and four recent events. Stlican Shelf records 57 changes, 3,418 Colonial and 3,325 Warden losses and 421 enlistees, seven flips in the last two hours. Mooring County reports 11 total flips, 4,213 Colonial and 4,337 Warden dead, 543 recruits and five fresh events. Nevish Line holds nine flips, 6,340 Colonial and 6,120 Warden casualties, 692 enlistments but no new activity in the past two hours. The remaining regions show no base‑ownership movement and only modest casualty drift.
